ageGate.title: Adult Content
ageGate.body: This app is intended for **adults aged 18 and over**. Content includes sensual and intimate themes for couples. To continue:
ageGate.checkbox: I am 18+, will use this with **my partner** in mutual consent, and agree to the **Terms of Use**.

safety.reportProblemSub: Tell us about abuse or anything that feels wrong

safety.blockTextGuest: You'll leave this room and won't be able to join rooms this person creates in the future.
safety.leaveGuest: You'll leave this room. Your partner keeps the boxes, and you can rejoin with the code.
safety.leaveHostHandover: Your partner becomes the room owner and keeps the boxes. You can rejoin with the code.
safety.leaveHostClose: You're alone in this room, so leaving deletes it together with all its boxes.

safety.reportFootnote: Reports go only to the Wisp & Flame team, never to your partner. We review every report within 24 hours.
safety.reportSentText: We'll review it within 24 hours. If you feel unsafe, you can remove and block your partner now.
safety.noticeRemoved: Your partner removed you from the room.
safety.noticeClosed: That room was closed by its owner.
